Method of Attack: spoofing vulnerability exploiting Windows CryptoAPI (CVE-2020-0601) to spoof code-signing certificates and enable man-in-the-middle attacks, remote code execution, and spoofing of Authenticode signatures
Attack Vector: spoofed code-signing certificates used to sign malicious executables
Indicators of Compromise: crafted certificates exploiting the certificate validation vulnerability detected by updated Windows Defender
Windows Event Viewer logs exploitation attempts
detection signatures updated by Crowdstrike and Microsoft Defender ATP
